verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a dedicated Trademark Litigation practice covering trademark prosecution, portfolio policing, and related contracts (licenses, co-existence, settlement agreements), plus a broader IP Litigation team with trademark expertise recognized by Chambers. However, there is no explicit mention of trademark clearance or registration services specifically, and no standalone 'brand enforcement' team description beyond litigation-focused enforcement. Missing for 10: dedicated trademark clearance/search services, registration/prosecution workflow details, and a distinctly named brand enforcement offering separate from litigation.
